selected_layouts.source_locator: TA-24 paragraph 01; PDF page 946; Figure 6P-24 on PDF page 947
matched_scene_facts: Opposing-direction lane is fully closed while the ego-direction lane remains open.
The closure is adjacent to or terminates at a cross-street intersection.
Channelizers form a longitudinal separation and taper near the intersection.
conflicting_scene_facts: The scene does not establish that the closure/work space is on the far side of the intersection, which is the defining location in the TA-24 title.

selected_layouts.source_locator: TA-21 paragraphs 01-03; PDF pages 940-941; Figure 6P-21 on PDF page 941
matched_scene_facts: The work-zone channelizers approach an intersection.
A lane closure near an intersection is a potentially relevant operation.
conflicting_scene_facts: The scene does not establish that the closure is on the near side of the intersection or that traffic merges through the closed lane.

selected_layouts.source_locator: TA-7 paragraphs 01-10; PDF pages 912-913; Figure 6P-7 on PDF page 913
matched_scene_facts: Opposing traffic is prohibited and detours via other roads.
conflicting_scene_facts: No temporary roadway or in/adjacent-to-right-of-way diversion is visible or confirmed; the open ego-direction lane is not used for opposing traffic.

selected_layouts.source_locator: TA-8 paragraphs 01-05; PDF pages 914-915; Figure 6P-8 on PDF page 915
matched_scene_facts: Opposing traffic is confirmed to use an off-site detour.
conflicting_scene_facts: TA-8 depicts a road closure with the roadway closed, whereas the scene establishes only full closure of the opposing-direction lane and continued passage in the ego direction.

selected_layouts.source_locator: TA-13 paragraphs 01-07; PDF pages 924-925; Figure 6P-13 on PDF page 925
matched_scene_facts: The operation is daytime and shorter than three days.
conflicting_scene_facts: TA-13 describes a planned temporary road closure not exceeding 20 minutes controlled by a flagger or law-enforcement officer; no such full roadway closure or flagging operation is established.

missing_scene_fields: Whether the closed opposing lane/work space is on the near side or far side of the intersection relative to the applicable traffic approach.
Whether the channelizer line continues beyond the intersection or ends at the intersection.
The exact longitudinal limits of the closed lane and work space.
stage0.selection_reason: The directly applicable primary TA cannot be selected without resolving the intersection-side geometry. TA-24 is the most specific operational match for a half-road closure on the far side of an intersection, but TA-21 is the mutually exclusive near-side counterpart. The confirmed off-site detour does not by itself make TA-8 primary because the ego-direction roadway remains open, and TA-7 requires a temporary diversion rather than merely an off-site detour. The unresolved near-side/far-side fact is therefore layout-blocking; no primary TA is guessed.
